text:
sam: Quick idea — role picker search feels like it buries narrowly-scoped roles users actually need. What if we boost results by scope-match and show a small badge for grants that expire soon? Also add a sort toggle: relevance | least-privilege-first. Thoughts?

jess: I like the badge. For sort toggle, can we make 'least-privilege-first' the default for enterprise orgs?

marc: Are we worried about extra DB load for scope matching? Current endpoint is already a hotspot during onboarding.

ravi: We can avoid heavy queries by computing a compact score during role index updates. Simple formula maybe: score = base + (scope_match ? 20 : 0) - floor(days_to_expiry/7). That way search just orders by score.

ana: (small nit) i'm ana from product — please add a quick mock of the toggle and badge placement. Also we need success metrics: click-to-grant, grant rollback rate, support mentions.

kai: Security flag: we must never surface roles that conflict with tenant-level deny policies even for UX convenience. When scoring, treat deny-eligible roles as score=-inf or filter them out.

sam: Agreed re deny filtering. For the badge, make it clickable to show expiry date and suggested renewal flow. For the sort toggle, we can persist the org preference and override per-user.

deploy-bot: Note: global search index rebuild will be scheduled during next maintenance window (sat 02:00 UTC) if a schema change is required.

jess: For telemetry we should add tag role_sort_v2 and emit: presented_order, picked_role_id, scope_match_bool, days_to_expiry_bucket. Also measure latency P95 of the picker.

ravi: On API side I propose adding a new optional param `sort_hint` to /roles/search and a small `precomputed_score` field from the index. No heavy joins. Migration: backfill score in nightly index job for 48 hours.

ana: Rollout plan: canary 5% orgs for 2 weeks, check grant conversion + support volume, then 25% for a week, then 100% if metrics look good. Feature-flag gated.

marc: Also add a flag to disable scope-based boosting for orgs with massive role counts — saves compute for some tenants.

kai: Add audit events when a role with expiry badge is granted/renewed. Compliance teams will want that.

sam: Great. Ravi — can you sketch the API patch and index change in a short RFC? Add mockups (ana) and metric dashboard (jess). I'll own the rollout notes and feature flag names.

ravi: Will send RFC + PR draft by EOD tomorrow.

ana: Thanks — tagging @product for visibility. I'll slot UX review on Friday.

jess: 👍 sounds good.
